title: Kaathil Oru Kinnaram
desc: Hari is dejected when he learns that he cannot marry his lover until her elder sister is married off first. Desperate, he enlists the help of a marriage broker to find a suitable match.

title: Chettayees
desc: Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.

title: June
desc: June, a teenager, believes that there is nothing remarkable about her. She experiences adolescent crushes, handles heartbreaks and fights insecurities as she grows into a mature and confident woman.

title: Aalibabayum Aarara Kallanmarum
desc: Diwakaran, a thief, steals jewellery from Aravindakshan, a school teacher. Jayashankar, a police officer who in reality is Diwakaran's brother-in-law, is appointed to investigate the case.

title: Kudamattam
desc: Appukuttan and Gauri meet during a village festival. After some constant fights, they fall in love but her brother, Shivan Kutty, has a different plan for her.
